mapper.insert: insert into cm_security_events ( id, user_id, identity_id, event_type, event_result, risk_level, ip, user_agent, device_id, detail_json, created_at ) values ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{identityId}, #{eventType}, #{eventResult}, #{riskLevel}, #{ip}, #{userAgent}, #{deviceId}, #{detailJson}, current_timestamp )
mapper.select: select se.id, se.user_id as userId, se.identity_id as identityId, se.event_type as eventType, se.event_result as eventResult, se.risk_level as riskLevel, se.ip, se.user_agent as userAgent, se.device_id as deviceId, cast(se.detail_json as char) as detailJson, se.created_at as createdAt, u.account_name as accountName, ai.provider from cm_security_events se left join cm_users u on u.id = se.user_id left join cm_auth_identities ai on ai.id = se.identity_id where se.id = #{id} limit 1
